description: Golden programs assembled in the layout of decoder.encode into tri_asm.zig's twelve-byte container and run by a Python model of executor.zig; negatives for an invalid register, an invalid opcode, division by zero, the stack guard, a fetch past memory, RET underflow and the budget; loader vectors for every rejection rule of loader.zig. Replayed through the generated C of the three specs by `run`.

entry_profiles.cli: the file at byte 0, pc 3, sp 0 (CPUState.init + memcpy: test_golden.zig, `tri tri27 run`)
entry_profiles.loader: loader.load: code in eight-byte words from word 3, pc 0, sp 19682 (tri_emu_main.zig, no build target)

not_replayed: STR_LOAD, STR_CONCAT, STR_PRINT, FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_EXISTS (host I/O by opcode); cpu.f and the vector registers (never read by an executed opcode); SACR modes 2..4 (unreachable through the decoder)
vector_name: Trinity TRI-27 golden programs, negatives and loader vectors

vectors.note: HALT sets H and leaves pc where it is
plain i64 addition, Z and N from the result
the fifteen-bit immediate at both ends
a loop through JNZ; the label counts from word 3
JGT not taken, JLT taken, JZ not taken
MOV copies, INC and DEC act on dst, DIV truncates toward zero
AND is bitwise, OR and XOR are the owner's ternary-shaped rules, NOT complements dst

DOT, BIND and BUNDLE2 read their second operand from t0 because the word cannot carry src2; a zero operand is BIND's identity even for a negative value; BUNDLE3 carries three registers in the raw word
the three scaled constants clear Z and N; the decoded SACR adds modulo 19683 whatever mode the source wrote
fixed-point Taylor series scaled by 1000
ST writes the low 32 bits at a byte address, LD reads a word index times four and sign-extends, STI stores a clamped trit at byte |imm|
SYSCALL advances pc and does nothing
CALL pushes its own address and RET returns to it: the pair is an endless loop with sp alternating between 4 and 8, stopped by the budget after 33333 rounds; nonzero status
an endless jump stops at 100000 instructions; the owner reports a plain halt, the replay a nonzero status
RET pops a return address that ST overwrote with 262128; the fetch at byte 1048512 is past memory and the run stops silently in the owner, nonzero here
RET with sp < 4 sets H and returns no error in the owner; nonzero here
ADD with dst 27 (a five-bit field can name 27..31) is refused before it counts as executed
ADD3, SUB3, CMP3 are declared and fall through to InvalidOpcode
DIV by a zero register
the string and file opcodes are not replayed; the replay stops with its own status
a loader-native container: after loader.load the code sits in eight-byte words from word 3 and pc is 0, so six zero fetches run as NOP, then LDI at pc 6, a zero fetch at 7, then HALT at 8
a loader-native container: after loader.load sp is 19682 and the first CALL (at pc 6) overflows the stack guard

the writer's twelve-byte container is accepted, pc 0, sp 19682, but the loader takes its code from byte 10: the two padding bytes lead the first word and every word is shifted by two bytes (bytes 26, 27, 32 and 34 change instead of 24, 25, 26 and 32)
the ten-byte container the loader expects: the two words land whole at words 3 and 4
five bytes: Truncated before the magic is read
the magic in the other byte order: InvalidMagic
version 2: InvalidVersion
version 0: InvalidVersion
section id 9: InvalidSection
a section id with no header behind it: Truncated
the code header promises eight bytes and two follow: Truncated
zero sections: SectionMissing, decided after pc and sp are set
a BSS section and no code: SectionMissing
19686 code bytes at offset 10: 19696 exceeds the 19683 words the check compares against: DataTooLarge
19673 code bytes at offset 10 fit exactly; 4918 words land from word 3
a CONSTANTS section (the id byte read as the count 2, sixteen bytes skipped) and a BSS section before the code: accepted, cpu.f untouched
a CONSTANTS section written as the documents say (id, count 1, eight bytes): the loader skips sixteen bytes from the count byte and lands inside the code that follows
three data bytes land one per word from word index 8, the code size in bytes
the data header promises five bytes and one follows: Truncated
nine code bytes in a loader-native container: two words are packed, the ninth byte is dropped
